declare @$unitName nvarchar(1023), @$allocationUnit char(1), @message nvarchar(4000) select @$allocationUnit = '0' if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' and val = '1') select @$allocationUnit = '1' select @message = 'var f = this;f._costUnit = ' + @$allocationUnit + ';'

action.text: declare @deny tinyint if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' and val = '1') begin if exists (select 1 from dmdvcs where ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs2) if @@admin <> 1 and not exists (select 1 from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs2 and r_edit = 1) select @deny = 1 end select isnull(@deny, 0) as c return
